title: Before You Sign: 10 Clauses Every Founder Should Understand
desc:
Before You Sign: 10 Clauses Every Founder Should Understand

The legal terms you agree to in your earliest financing rounds can have lasting implications for your company, your fundraising journey, and your ownership. Yet many founders sign SAFEs, convertible notes, and financing documents without fully understanding the provisions that matter most because they focus too much on the check size.

Join us for an interactive practical discussion on the legal considerations every founder should understand before raising capital.

Keynote
Colin Kirby, Foley Hoag, Emerging Companies and Venture Capital Fochair

Colin will walk founders through the most important legal provisions in early-stage financing documents, explaining what they mean in practice, which terms deserve closer attention, and how founders can avoid common mistakes before they become costly.

Fireside Chat

Following the keynote, Victoria Yampolsky from The Startup Station will moderate a panel with three founders and one investor for a candid discussion on legal trends in today's fundraising market, including:

• Current trends in SAFEs and convertible notes
• Valuation caps and discount rates across today's market
• Founder-friendly vs. investor-friendly terms
• Common legal mistakes that delay or complicate fundraising
• Critical clauses that founders should understand before signing
• When walking away from a deal is the right decision

Fireside Chat Panelists

Chad McClennan - President & CEO, Koios Medical, a healthcare AI company developing FDA-cleared software that helps radiologists improve cancer detection and diagnostic accuracy. A recognized voice in healthcare innovation, Chad frequently speaks on AI in medicine and delivered a TEDx talk on the future of machine learning in radiology.

title: Yorkseed NYC | The Holiday Soirée
desc:
🎄 Yorkseed NYC | The Holiday Soirée

A Global Year. A New York Celebration. 🥂

What a year it’s been! And what better way to wrap up 2026 than bringing everyone together for one festive night in New York City?

Join Yorkseed at Mason Jar NYC for an evening of holiday cheer, great conversations, and unexpected connections with founders, investors, VCs, entrepreneurs, and friends from across our global network.

No panels. No pitches. Just great people and good vibes.

🌍 From New York to the World

2026 has been an extraordinary year for Yorkseed, growing our global venture ecosystem across 50+ city hubs on five continents, connecting founders, investors, and capital through curated gatherings and our venture platform.

One of our most unforgettable moments happened in Lisbon.

When severe weather shut down Web Summit on its second day, Yorkseed and a group of investors came together to organize Wet Summit, a spontaneous investor pop-up summit, in less than 16 hours.

The result? 180+ investor registrations, nearly $1 billion in represented assets under management, and news coverage!

Dubbed “The Best Event at Web Summit,” it was a reminder of what makes this network special: people who show up, make things happen, and turn unexpected moments into extraordinary opportunities.

From Yorkseed House started in NYC to our growing international presence (Paris, Lisbon), we’re proud of what we’ve built together.

And 2027 is already looking exciting!

Next up, our official community partnership and delegation to the Asian Financial Forum in Hong Kong, followed by plans for a curated family office and investor delegation to Techarena in Stockholm.

But first, let’s celebrate!

🎄 Ugly Sweaters, Big Personalities!

Dust off your most outrageous Christmas sweater!

Reindeer, sequins, flashing lights, ridiculous patterns. The uglier, the better!

Whether you’re rocking an ugly sweater or showing up in festive chic, come ready to laugh, mingle, and make new friends.

title: ✨ A Christmas Affair in Paris | By Yorkseed 🥂
venue: Private Art Gallery, Rue Saint-Honoré, Paris
desc:
An Evening of Art, Global Connections & Parisian Christmas Magic.

Paris in December. The magic of Christmas. A beautiful private art gallery on the iconic Rue Saint-Honoré. And a room filled with extraordinary people from around the world.

Some evenings are simply meant to be remembered. ✨

As an extraordinary 2026 comes to a close, Yorkseed invites you to A Christmas Affair in Paris, an intimate holiday celebration bringing together founders, investors, venture capitalists, family offices, entrepreneurs, and friends from our global community.

What a year it’s been!

From New York to Paris, Lisbon to Hong Kong, we’ve been building bridges across borders, bringing capital and innovation closer together, and creating opportunities through meaningful relationships.

Now, before we turn the page to 2027, we’re bringing a little of that global energy to the heart of Paris.

No conference badges. No pitch decks. No formalities.

Just beautiful art, festive elegance, sparkling conversations, and a room full of people worth knowing. 🥂

🌍 From New York to the World

2026 has been an extraordinary year for Yorkseed, growing our global venture ecosystem across 50+ city hubs on five continents, connecting founders, investors, and capital through curated gatherings and our venture platform.

One of our most unforgettable moments happened in Lisbon.

When severe weather shut down Web Summit on its second day, Yorkseed and a group of investors came together to organize Wet Summit, a spontaneous investor pop-up summit, in less than 16 hours.

The result? 180+ investor registrations, nearly $1 billion in represented assets under management, and news coverage!

Dubbed “The Best Event at Web Summit,” it was a reminder of what makes this network special: people who show up, make things happen, and turn unexpected moments into extraordinary opportunities.

From Yorkseed House started in NYC to our growing international presence (Paris, Lisbon), we’re proud of what we’ve built together.

And 2027 is already looking exciting!

Next up, our official community partnership and delegation to the Asian Financial Forum in Hong Kong, followed by plans for a curated family office and investor delegation to Techarena in Stockholm.

But first, let’s celebrate — in Paris. 🥂

✨ Festive Elegance, Parisian Style

Come dressed for the occasion: cocktail attire, a touch of sparkle, holiday glamour. Think Parisian chic meets Christmas magic.

Whether you’re a founder, an investor, or simply someone who loves great art and great company, come ready to toast to an extraordinary year and an even bigger 2027.
